_note: The Dubai Life Marathon (weekly, free). Mirrored in supabase/migrations/*_marathon.sql: the Friday 19:00 GST start, the 15-minute race window, the course length, the top speed and the prizes (checked by scripts/check-life-config.mjs). The course plays in game metres; the distance shown is scaled (×10) so the full course reads as a marathon. Locals run alongside for company but never enter or rank.
